target.statement: Determine whether a PIFB2-type continuum action on belief, model, and frame sections can be made mathematically rigorous under explicit hypotheses, while its live-peer KL sector remains generically distinct from the ordinary state-level ELBO of one fixed normalized joint; determine the resulting role of the exact ELBO theory.
target.quantifiers: For every finite agent cover and every admissible section configuration satisfying the frozen analytic hypotheses, require a well-defined gauge-covariant action; do not require that every live-peer configuration family be representable by one fixed state-level joint on the original variables.
domains: A compact smooth measured base manifold C with a finite agent cover by domains U_i.
Belief and model statistical bundles with admissible section spaces and overlap transports.
Finite directed overlap graphs with categorical attention fields on nonempty active neighbor sets.
codomains: The extended real line for the unreduced action.
The real line on the finite-action admissible subset.
target.regularity: Measurable data for definition; smooth finite-dimensional fibers and Sobolev sections for variation; uniform covariance ellipticity or an explicit extended-real boundary convention; coercivity and weak lower semicontinuity for any minimizer theorem.
measures: A declared finite positive Borel measure on C, or a volume measure induced by separately declared geometric data.
Categorical measures on active neighbor sets with extended-real relative entropy at support boundaries.
boundary_conditions: Either C has no boundary or variational boundary conditions are declared before integration by parts.
Every active attention row has nonempty prior support.
symmetries: Fiber-coordinate changes under which statistical laws and transports transform by the declared pushforward and conjugation laws.
An independent connection has its own gauge law; pure frame transport alone is not assigned nonzero curvature.
target.equivalence: An exact state-level ELBO means equality up to a configuration-independent constant for one fixed normalized joint on the same original sample variables. A Gibbs law on whole section configurations is a distinct meta-level construction.
premises: Agents are section-bearing objects with belief, model, and frame data on their base domains.
Overlap interactions compare transported statistical laws at the same base point.
The full PIFB2 functional may be postulated as an effective action; exact probabilistic semantics are established sector by sector.
modeling_postulates: Local self-VFE, transported peer KL, attention entropy, model-channel, and optional spatial or connection terms are constitutive action terms.
Physical interpretation requires a later operational map from fields and coefficients to observables and units.
search_priors: The current PIFB2 manuscript labels the complete population functional an action ansatz.
The exact-ELBO manuscript separates finite law-level VFE from section configurations and requires an additional lift to connect them.
permitted_theorems: KL invariance under bijective pushforward and standard Gaussian KL formulas.
The Gibbs variational principle on a separately normalized configuration probability space.
The direct method only after coercivity, compactness, closedness, and lower-semicontinuity are checked.
target.falsification_criterion: Refute the action claim by an admissible configuration for which a declared term is undefined or gauge dependent; refute the scoped non-ELBO claim by a fixed normalized joint reproducing arbitrary moving-peer fields without changing the sample space or adding configuration normalization.
target.literature_policy: Use current manuscript equations as primary evidence for claim scope and record the exact hypotheses of every imported theorem.
